snippet.title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park DLC - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Echoes of Central Park launches November 3, 2026.
Pre-order now and unlock the Central Park-inspired mask at launch.
 
Tom Clancy's The Division® 2: Echoes of Central Park invites agents to explore New York's iconic landmark for the first time in the franchise's history.
 
When the Division intercepts a mysterious distress signal deep within the park, agents are deployed to extract a high-value target. What begins as a rescue mission soon becomes a journey through a place overtaken by fear, mystery, and a new apex threat lurking in the shadows.
 
Echoes of Central Park is a narrative-driven expansion set after Warlords of New York. Play solo or in co-op as you explore Central Park and the Upper West Side, fight alongside unique companions, earn powerful new gear including a brand-new Exotic Weapon, unlock new skill variants, and uncover the truth behind the mystery consuming New York's iconic landmark. It also includes a Level 40 boost for players ready to jump straight into the action.
 
Echoes of Central Park is a DLC for Tom Clancy's The Division® 2 and requires the base game to play.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.

#Ubisoft #TheDivision2

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
